notes: The Companion Aisha is not written as a link. Her act (the ghusl she shows) is described, not her words (rule 6, as with «أن عمر رأى حلة»), so the report ends at أبا سلمة.
«قال يزيد بن هارون وبهز والجدي عن شعبة» names other transmitters of the same report: a variant group, not a route.
The remark «قال أبو عبد الله» is the compiler's own; not written.
